notes.title: Beyond the Wizard will be converted to a free game on August 1st!
notes.content:
I've heard from the previous announcement that we're going to offer you a game for free of charge.

We're able to offer you a free game faster than expected!


Meet Beyond the Wizard, which will be converted to a free game on August 1st!


After the price update, you can meet at Steam without paying a separate fee!

notes.title: Beyond the Wizard will soon be a free game!
notes.content:
It's been a little over a year since Beyond the Wizard was launched.

To begin with, we're going to turn this game into a completely free game!


Beyond the Wizard's free game conversion is scheduled for August.

We're going to give you a re-announcement after the full free time. Thank you.
